page.overview:
Who is Five Constellation Lords?

The are a group of attendants of the Jade Emperor.

When Sun Wukong was given the meaningless title of Great Sage Equal to Heaven, the Five Constellation Lords escorted him to his new offices. They and Sun Wukong then partied together and drank wine.
